title: AI-Assisted Identification of the Medial Lingual Foramen on CBCT: A Deep Learning Approach for Preoperative Implant Assessment.
summary: nnU-Net/U-Net-derived segmentation trained on manually annotated CBCT scans identifies the medial lingual foramen; seven-patient internal test Dice 0.79, and separate 10-scan clinic validation Dice 0.81 with 9/10 detections. Feasibility/localization only; small external set and no prospective utility.
ai_technology: §2: nnU-Net auto-configured U-Net CNN trained on annotated CBCT canal trajectories.
